context:
Goal: every page feedback you give, on any repo's page, reaches the shared page template mechanically (your words, 09:13 CST Nov 10).
Problem (rule): the one route that works from your Mac and from the cloud is an outbox note on a record branch, and claude-settings triage reading another repo needs your word first.
Based on (read): skill project-ops names an outbox note on the record branch as the cross-repo hand-off, and claude-settings' outbox already holds notes about banchi, home and mailaudit.
Based on (measured): the session-to-session send works only between cloud sessions, and the record-branch guard refused the coordinator's own outbox file in q_max at 11:14 CST (a filed note says that may be a false alarm).
Departs from: main (page feedback from other repos reaches claude-settings by hand) — each repo's page writer leaves the note in its own repo's outbox, and claude-settings triage reads those outboxes at each wake and turns each note into a template step.
Meanwhile: triage builds the claude-settings half (comments on this repo's page become template steps), which needs no new access.

options.gain: Feedback on every repo's page reaches the template, from the Mac and the cloud alike.
options.how: Each repo's page writer writes the note in its own outbox; claude-settings triage gets read access to q_max, banchi, degen, home and mailaudit and reads their outboxes at each wake. No guard changes.
options.label: Yes, triage reads each repo's outbox
options.lose: Triage reads 5 more repos at each wake, one fetch each.

options.gain: No session writes outside its own repo.
options.how: Other repos send page feedback through the session mailbox once its fix lands.
options.label: No, wait for the session mailbox
options.lose: Feedback on other repos' pages stays manual until the mailbox works from the Mac.

reply:
You picked a, with the session mailbox as the end state (12:00 CST): "eventually session mailbox though -- you should find there already is a lot in the repo's outboxes for the claude-settings triage though. propose a plan to aggregate all of those findings so that the outbox clears from the other repos, and then let me know later how you'd want that mechanized".

What the sweep found (12:14 CST, read-only, 5 repos): the outbox folders hold nothing addressed to claude-settings. Each one holds only a note the other way, from the claude-settings coordinator to that repo's triage. The backlog for claude-settings lives in other places: home's 8 steps marked "Hand-off to claude-settings" plus 6 debts and steps, degen 2, banchi 3, q_max 2 to 4, joyous 0. That is about 23 items, of which about 6 already have a claude-settings step. Claude-settings' own outbox holds about 12 more unfiled items about other repos. mailaudit has no clone here, so it is unread.

Plan to clear them:
1. An agent reads each item in full against the claude-settings steps and marks it fold (into a named step) or new. I start it now.
2. Triage files each one: a new step or a fold note, citing the source repo and path.
3. For each repo, triage sends the coordinator the list "source item -> claude-settings step". The coordinator already writes a file in each repo's outbox, so it adds the list there. That repo's triage then closes its hand-off steps and debts. Triage itself writes nothing in another repo.
4. The 11 notes the coordinator sent the other way stay with each repo's triage.

Status (12:24 CST): steps 1 to 3 are done. The agent read 38 items: 14 became new claude-settings steps, 15 were folded into existing steps, 3 were already done on main, and 5 belong to the repo they came from. That is roadmap commit 833b0c472. Four claude-settings outbox files are cleared in commit ba8d86b0e. The coordinator has the "source item -> step" list for each repo, so each repo's triage can close its hand-offs. Only you can do one item: your project roster still names threads that are resolved.

How I would make it mechanical, for later: each repo puts claude-settings hand-offs in one file, roadmap/outbox/claude-settings.md. Claude-settings triage fetches that file at each wake (one fetch per repo), files each line, and writes the step slug back, through the mailbox once it works from the Mac and the cloud. A check in each repo refuses a hand-off step left in its own roadmap, so hand-offs have one home.
title: May claude-settings triage read each repo's outbox, so page feedback on any repo's page reaches the shared template?
why: It works today from both your Mac and the cloud, it changes no guard, and every session still writes only in its own repo.
